scope: Only the existing recording progress count publication differs between A/B. No new product measurement probes; existing Phase1A runner, analyzer, fixture and accepted observer boundaries remain unchanged.
orderMeaning: Nine adjacent A/B pairs alternate AB/BA. With three repeats per contrast, one arm starts twice and the other once; overall five AB and four BA pairs. Every arm/condition/mode/repeat occurs once.
childPlanContract: Driver deterministically projects nine unique condition/mode/repeat rows accepted by each arm own unchanged Phase1A runner. Raw plan hash is the projected child hash; outer receipts link parent hash, child hash, global index, arm, product root/source/tree/BUILD_ID and actual raw path.
identityContract: A product HEAD must equal reviewed baseline. Both arm HEAD/tree and served normal/profile BUILD_ID must match the separate build receipt; source stays clean before and after each run. Driver source/tree and file hashes are recorded separately. A tool HEAD cannot stand in for the served product source.
budgetContract: Aggregate all retained bytes in both arm output/playwright trees and every priorEvidenceRoots tree, canonicalized without duplicate subtrees. Includes all failed/exploratory/formal artifacts, build logs, reports, original review ZIP and transport parts. Changing output directory does not reset the 250 MiB budget. Check before/during/after runs; stop partial and retain evidence on excess.
timingContract: Page real performance.now actual delivery cohort [t0,t1), unchanged subscription/recording denominators and continuously running transport during 3 s drain. CDP has its own seconds domain and includes drain. 20 s x3 is not endurance/statistical-significance evidence.
metricContract: Independent delivered RC cohort, decoded/published/subscriber/recorded/saved reconciliation and order/session/causal checks.
Per-boundary callback/s and callbacks per actual delivered RC frame; do not require identical A/B input counts or equate callbacks to FPS.
Render distributions within each boundary; nested boundaries overlap.
CDP TaskDuration/Timestamp delta, input interval distributions, storage/cleanup/buffer evidence.
Ordinary count publication, forced boundary updates and display freshness are established by separate deterministic functional tests; no unfair A/B probe is added.
stopContract: Any old Phase1A observation/tool file changed.
Raw/source/session/subscription/persistence integrity failure or missing Profiler positive control.
Unexpected network/device/user-data access or collector/fixture overflow.
Source/build mismatch, resource ceiling, batch/run deadline or unresolved owned process cleanup.
cleanupContract: One owned server and one child runner/browser at a time. TERM then bounded KILL of owned process groups; preserve abnormal cleanup evidence. Reserve final 20 s within the 30 min batch ceiling. Context/process exit is not product track.stop or write cancellation proof.
freezePrerequisites: Separate A/B product SHA/tree and normal/profile BUILD_ID receipts.
Exact clean tested source and driver identity; immutable Phase1A hash check.
Observed P1 mount/update and P0 regression, actual browser/React/viewport or explicit unavailable fields.
Functional count/final-freeze/freshness tests and source checks complete.
Budget roots and local-only path disclosure reviewed; no formal start until root freezes/commits this plan.

runtimeFields.normalRuntimeReactVersionReason: Not directly exposed in ordinary capture; installed React version is not substituted for runtime evidence.
runtimeFields.gpuReason: Not observed; no hardware acceleration claim.

receiptBinding: Final plan commit/hash and product/driver source/build receipt are external to avoid self-reference. Frozen status alone does not prove checks/builds/formal runs.
localOnlyPaths: roots and priorEvidenceRoots resolve relative to the B driver worktree; emitted absolute local paths need sanitization in a separate share copy.

counterPublicationEvidence.formalAB: No new product probes. Raw/commit comparison keeps identical accepted Phase1A measurement boundaries on both arms.
counterPublicationEvidence.functional: Controlled-interval hook tests verify ordinary paired count changes, exact boundary values, transaction distinction, lifecycle invalidation and late callbacks. Isolated DOM recording test separately observes actual displayed changes and timestamps; these are not formal A/B performance counts.
counterPublicationEvidence.unavailable: Per-publication React state scheduling counts and exact paint latency are not exposed by the unchanged formal collector; do not substitute whole subtree callback counts or zero.

analysisContract.rawDenominator: Each run owns its independently delivered RC cohort and drain. A/B delivered sample counts may differ.
analysisContract.perBoundary: Retain callback/s and callback/eligible delivered RC frame for recording-ui, telemetry-display, workbench and throttle-timeline separately; never sum nested duration.
analysisContract.paired: B minus A for the same condition, mode and repeat; all three repeats retained. Report per-run and paired values plus mean/median/min/max; no significance claim.
analysisContract.ordinary: Compare S2 N using common CDP/fixture/save observables; internal probes remain unavailable.
analysisContract.rendererTask: TaskDuration delta / CDP Timestamp delta including declared drain and control overhead; not whole-machine CPU.
analysisContract.outcome: Mechanism, correctness, repeatable benefit and regressions reported separately. No benefit assumption or expansion to other product layers.

driverObservationOverhead: The same outer process checks cumulative evidence bytes/free disk once per second and between runs for both arms. These filesystem checks are common test-control overhead, not claimed zero overhead; evidence set grows in frozen order.

hostEnvironment.gpu: unqueried; no acceleration or hardware-rate claim

offlineSummarizer.selfTest: 11 mathematical/edge checks passed; real-input execution occurs only after formal batch
offlineSummarizer.percentiles: Per-boundary render duration uses linear interpolation; do not equate these values with different percentile methods or sum nested durations.

preFreezeEvidence.sourceDelta: Only browser evidence retention and plan environment metadata changed after initial lifecycle controls; production hook unchanged. Final gates/builds bind the frozen tested commit separately.

uiObservation.limits: DOM publication observation, not state setter count, paint latency, video FPS, physical timing or formal A/B performance. Boundary phase affects the observed frequency.

preFreezeEvidence.lifecycleOutcome: 3/3 valid; owned server process closed; P0 disabled with zero events; P1 genuine mount/update/nested-update observed.
preFreezeEvidence.unitOutcome: 742 tests/typecheck/lint at prototype; 16 controlled progress tests plus 28 legacy tests passed; final exact-source gates required before formal launch.
preFreezeEvidence.retentionCorrection: ui-prototype-01 passed but body attachments were not retained by line reporter; ui-prototype-02 writes actual JSON files; first log preserved.

finalGateRequirement: Before formal run, exact clean frozen tested B HEAD must pass full check and complete smoke suite; A/B canonical normal/profile builds must be analytics-disabled, with actual BUILD_ID receipts. Smoke builds have a separate analytics-test configuration and are not reused for the formal comparison.
